Does HardMoney Company provide renovation funds?: Yes. HardMoney Company can finance renovation costs on qualifying fix-and-flip projects. Its current PLL program indicates up to 100% of the rehab budget and states that rehab funds may be advanced at closing.

Does HardMoney Company offer cash-out refinance loans?: Yes. HardMoney Company considers business-purpose equity cash-out refinances on qualifying investment properties. Current maximum leverage is up to 75% LTV for residential properties and 70% for multifamily properties.

Does HardMoney Company finance condominiums?: Yes. HardMoney Company has dedicated condominium purchase and refinance bridge programs. Current guidelines list maximum leverage of 60% of the purchase price or as-is property value.
